label: Anime Style
description: Anime aesthetics described by their visual characteristics — no studio or artist names, by policy.

items.name: pastoral-painterly
items.text: painterly pastoral anime style, hand-painted watercolor backgrounds, soft clouds and nostalgic summer light

items.name: 90s-cel
items.text: 90s cel anime style, hand-inked lines, limited palettes, film grain and halation glow

items.name: modern-sakuga
items.text: modern sakuga style, crisp digital lines, dynamic perspective and effects-heavy motion energy

items.name: cinematic-keyvisual
items.text: cinematic anime key visual, dramatic sky, painstaking light bloom and poster-grade composition

items.name: chibi
items.text: chibi style, tiny rounded proportions, oversized heads and joyful simplicity

items.name: watercolor-soft
items.text: soft watercolor anime style, translucent washes, delicate lines and gentle pastel light

items.name: dark-seinen
items.text: dark seinen style, heavy inks, gritty crosshatching and muted desaturated palettes

items.name: shoujo-sparkle
items.text: shoujo style, luminous eyes, flower motifs, sparkle overlays and airy linework

items.name: flat-web
items.text: flat modern web-anime style, bold graphic shapes, minimal shading and vivid color blocking

items.name: retro-manga
items.text: retro manga style, screentone dots, expressive brush lines and black-and-white drama
